verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own HTTP API for sending event data from a source to connected destinations, plus a Pixel API for GET-based tracking, so a documented HTTP ingestion endpoint exists. The evidence does not show how requests are authenticated or what delivery guarantees apply, and delivery-error debugging is not the same as a delivery guarantee. missing for 10: documented authentication scheme (e.g. write key/basic auth), delivery guarantees (retries, durability, at-least-once semantics), server-to-server usage specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees
